name: Why God Created Man
overview: Scripture reveals that God created man intentionally in His own image, bestowing upon humanity a unique dignity and responsibility to exercise dominion over the earth and its creatures. Man was formed not only to steward creation, as seen in his placement in the Garden of Eden to work and keep it, but also to fulfill God's purposes through fruitfulness and multiplication. Ultimately, the reason for man's creation is rooted in glorifying God, as every person is called by His name and made for His glory, with the whole duty of man being to fear God and keep His commandments.
